equipment_type: Water-cooled chiller and water-to-water heat pump controller
applies_to: Carrier Europe 30WG and 30WGA water-cooled/condenserless chillers and 61WG water-to-water heat pumps with SmartVu (PIC 6.0, software 11.x) or SmartVu 2.0 (PIC 6.1, software 1.x).
summary: These units speak BACnet IP when option 149 is activated with a software key. The object list has 274 objects: command objects written by the BMS carry a _wr suffix (start/stop, control point, demand limit, heat/cool select, occupancy), with read-back copies marked _rd, plus water temperatures, capacity, circuit data and one BV per alarm.
firmware: SmartVu PIC 6.0 SR 11.x / SmartVu 2.0 PIC 6.1 SR 1.x
notes: Source is the BACnet object spreadsheet inside Carrier's "protocols" zip for these units; the zip also holds Modbus and CCN/LON files that are not used here.
The spreadsheet also has a 38-entry trend log sheet; those are trend log objects pointing at points already listed, so they are not repeated.
No units column; temperatures follow the BACnet Metric Units setting (bacunit, default yes).
Condenser, free cooling, boiler and master/slave points only apply to units with those options.

integration.summary: Activate option 149 with the software key, enable BACnet in the Network menu (BACnet Standard Conf.), and set the operating type to Network. Then command the unit through the _wr objects: start/stop, control point, demand limit and heat/cool select, and read status, water temperatures, capacity and the alarm BVs.

minimum_points.name: GENUNIT_CTRL_PNT_wr
minimum_points.why: Control point (water temperature) from the BMS

integration.enable: The unit follows network commands only in Network operating type. In Network mode the start/stop and occupancy commands can be forced from the BMS; the network emergency stop works in any operating type.
setup: BACnet (option 149) needs a Software Activation Key before it can be enabled.
BACnet Standard Conf. defaults: BACnet Enable = disable, network 1600, UDP port 47808, manual device ID 1600001, auto device ID off.
IP port interface name (conifnam) selects J5/J15 (0) or J16 (1).
gotchas: Write the _wr objects; the _rd copies only report the active value.
BACnet_BMS_OCC (AV 144: 0=unocc, 1=occ, 2=none) works with the BACnet Manage Occupancy setting (mng_occ, default no); check how it interacts with CHIL_OCC before relying on it.
